name: Ferienwohnungen Rieder
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in the mountain village of Gerlos at over 1,200 metres altitude, Ferienwohnungen Rieder provides welcoming accommodations for outdoor sports enthusiasts and families, complete with modern kitchens and balconies overlooking the valley.

Lifts connecting to the vast Zillertal Arena, cross-country ski tracks, and scenic side valleys are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnungen Rieder in Gerlos offers alpine comfort and immediate proximity to the Zillertal Arena.
